subject: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Moore <dan.moore@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (Acme Health)

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the full buying committee joining the demo. Short recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Key takeaways (from demo):
- Technical fit: Redwood can meet the 100ms median latency target for the anonymized query workload we saw; KV caching + smaller quantized model variant looks promising.
- Decision criteria you emphasized: predictable per-token cost, SOC2 + customer data isolation, and a simple rollback path for model updates.
- Procurement concerns: legal wants a short data-processing addendum; procurement needs an expected TCO range and lead time for Dedicated capacity.

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Laura Chen (VP Finance) — cost & contract terms
- Procurement contact: Samir Patel — procurement point of contact and PO process
- Technical evaluation: Daniel Moore (CTO) + SRE team — security, SSO, logging
- Internal champion: (Samir) — product owner running the POC

Proposed next steps (I propose dates, please confirm):
1) Security packet: I attached a 1-pager SOC2 summary and can share our full security binder (on request). Requested by: Daniel — target: 03/03
2) Pricing + TCO: Rafael will send a two-tier pricing band (pilot vs committed) and a ballpark TCO model. Requested by: Laura — target: 03/04
3) POC SOW: I attached a POC SOW template. If we agree scope, we'll turn this into a short SOW and a pilot statement of work. Requested by: Samir — target: 03/06
4) Procurement path: Samir, can you confirm whether Acme will sign a standard PO or require a Master Services Agreement with redlines? If MSA, please share the main procurement milestones.

Deliverables attached: Redwood_Demo_Slides.pdf, SOC2-Summary.pdf, Redwood_POC_SOW_template.docx

Open question for the committee:
- Is the economic-buying decision tied to a calendar (e.g., end of quarter) or use-case success metrics? That will help prioritize the pilot scope.

I'll follow up with calendar invitations for the security deep-dive (tech) and the procurement sync. Thanks all — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Moore <dan.moore@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (Acme Health)

Thanks Neha — useful recap. A couple of clarifications from the finance side: 
- Decision timing: finance wants a signed commercial approval by 2026-03-24 to include in next quarter budgeting. So anything that pushes beyond that makes the committed capacity conversation harder.
- Pricing sensitivity: we will expect both a pilot (no long-term commitment) pricing band and a committed-rate for a 12-month reserved pool. Please include: monthly committed spend, overage rates, and sample cost-per-embedding.

Samir — procurement typically asks for an MSA for deals with data-processing elements. If we can get a clean SOW + MSA with a standard DPA, procurement can turn around in ~2–3 weeks once legal confirms redlines.

On security: Daniel — if you and SRE want, let's slot a 60-min session next week to review the SOC2 summary and SSO options.

Laura Chen
VP Finance, Acme Health
laura.chen@acmehealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:43:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (internal)

Neha — forwarding here with what I'll prepare based on the ask:
- "Committed" vs "Pilot" pricing bands (two SKUs + example monthly spend scenarios) — will include per-token and per-embedding estimates.
- Short TCO model with assumed QPS and burst profile (so we can show Dedicated vs hosted cost).
- Clean SOW for pilot with acceptance criteria (timeboxed, number of queries, latency target) and start/end dates.
- Quick legal pack: sample MSA + common redlines we accept and a DPA template.

I'll draft the pricing sheet today and share an internal link. Priyom — can you put together the latency/burst QPS numbers you measured in the demo and the sample KV-cache hit rate? We'll plug them into the TCO.

Rafael
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Moore <dan.moore@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (Acme Health)

Thanks — quick security checklist from our side before we go deeper:
1) SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months) — we need the report or an authorized summary for legal review.
2) Details on SSO (SAML/OIDC) + IdP integrations — our SRE will want to validate.
3) Data retention & deletion policy for customer data in logs and backups.
4) Audit log retention + access controls — list the roles that can access customer logs.

Procurement note: we prefer to run a 4–6 week pilot with a simple SOW and a PO to Redwood for the pilot. If pilot meets acceptance, we transition to an MSA + committed purchase order. Can you confirm Redwood can support PO-first pilots?

If you can get the SOC2 summary and SSO write-up to us by 03/03, I'll aim to have legal/procurement review before 03/17.

—Daniel (CTO)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Moore <dan.moore@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder map, procurement path & next steps (Acme Health)

Great — thanks for the clear asks. Quick confirmations and actions from Redwood: 
- SOC2: attached is a SOC2-Summary.pdf. We can provide the full report under an NDA; I included the standard point-of-contact for legal.
- SSO/SSO write-up: Priyom will send a short technical note on SAML/OIDC flows and IdP examples by EOD 03/03.
- Pilot/PO: Redwood can accept a PO for a timeboxed pilot (4 weeks). We commonly start pilots on a PO basis and convert to an MSA + committed PO if both sides agree. Rafael will send the pilot SOW and two-tier pricing by 03/04.

Next steps I'm scheduling now (you'll see invites):
- Security deep-dive (60m) — proposed: Wed 03/04 11:00 PT (Daniel + SRE)
- Procurement sync (30m) — proposed: Fri 03/06 09:30 PT (Samir + Laura + Rafael)
- Internal kickoff (Redwood) — Rafael & Priyom will prep deliverables and share the draft SOW by 03/04.

If that timeline works, Laura, can you confirm the 03/24 commercial approval window so we can prioritize the committed-rate modeling?

Thanks again — attaching Redwood_Demo_Slides.pdf and the POC SOW template for easier edits.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
